columns.name: guard_state
columns.meaning: what the holdings-price-return guard DID with this account-day: whether it graded the day at all, and if so whether it agreed. NON-NULL because it is how a consumer tells a guarded number from an unguarded one, and a null there is an unguarded number wearing no label.

columns.name: history_scope

columns.name: carried_days
columns.meaning: how many custodian partition days the flow window folded in; 1 on an ordinary day, more where a market closure was skipped by the calendar and its flows were carried forward

columns.name: method_version
columns.meaning: the dim_return_method row this figure was produced under

optional_columns.name: source
optional_columns.meaning: where this account-day's return comes from, named in words so a page can state it; one of the values below, and it names the source the return was computed from, not the emitter's code path
values: computed from Black Diamond values and flows
optional_columns.rule: An ABSENT or null source means the table was written before this column existed, or its emitter has not adopted the column yet; a page states NO source for such a table and never infers one from the other columns. A null is never a value of source.

i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.day_quality: domain: 'what does this account-day's number stand on'. MEASURED (the form computed and the guard agreed) | FLOW_UNRECONCILED (the form and the holdings-plus-income cross-check disagree beyond the measured tolerance) | LARGE_FLOW (the flow is a large share of the base; the value still enters) | NOT_MEASURABLE (no return is computable INSIDE the book -- non-positive prior value, or outside the plausibility band) | SOURCE_LAG (the custodian has not delivered the day). Covered by subtraction: a day is either emitted or not; an emitted day either has a computable base or not (NOT_MEASURABLE); a computable day either reconciles (MEASURED / LARGE_FLOW) or not (FLOW_UNRECONCILED); a day the feed has not delivered is SOURCE_LAG. A day BEFORE the account's first positive value is emitted as NO ROW AT ALL, which is why the domain says 'account-day' and not 'trading day' -- that case is outside the domain rather than a sixth member (ISSUER AMENDMENT 1).
i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.return_basis: domain: which arithmetic produced total_return_daily. TWR (the C-METHOD form) | NOT_MEASURABLE (no number is served). HOLDINGS_INCOME_FALLBACK is REMOVED: ruling 17 withdrew the substitution because the holdings return covers the priced, included, LONG basket while total_return_daily covers the whole account, so one cannot stand in for the other. Exhaustive by construction: the column is null iff the value is NOT_MEASURABLE.
i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.history_scope: domain: 'how much of this account's life does the table hold'. FULL | PARTIAL_HISTORY. Every round-1 row carries PARTIAL_HISTORY because the emit is a QA thread over six accounts and the all-accounts run is round 2; FULL is declared now so the value exists when that run lands, rather than being added as a schema change then.
i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.guard_state: domain: what the holdings guard did with this account-day, over EVERY EMITTED ROW. GRADED_AGREED (it ran inside the comparability domain and the difference was at or below the tolerance) | GRADED_DISAGREED (it ran and the difference exceeded the tolerance) | NOT_GRADED_OUTSIDE_DOMAIN (a usable neighbour return existed but the day fell outside the comparability domain: a short position, an excluded weight above the derived ceiling, a different valuation interval, or a non-OK holdings status) | NOT_GRADED_NO_NEIGHBOUR (no usable neighbour return existed for the account-day at all) | GUARD_NOT_REACHED (the day's verdict was settled before the guard was consulted: no usable V_(t-1), or F_t knowably incomplete through an absent transaction partition, an unvalued in-kind leg or an unparseable cash amount). COVERED BY SUBTRACTION, not by a forward list: every emitted row either reached the guard or did not; a row that reached it either had the day graded or not; graded splits on the tolerance; not-graded splits on whether a usable neighbour existed. There is no sixth state because those four questions are exhaustive and each answer is binary.

rule24_record.ii_same_grain: Every member of day_quality, return_basis and guard_state is an ACCOUNT-DAY property; history_scope is an ACCOUNT property carried on every row of that account and is the one deliberate grain exception, declared here rather than left to be noticed.
rule24_record.iii_intent_coherence: guard_state answers ONE question -- what the guard did -- and nothing else. It deliberately does NOT say whether the day is served (day_quality), which arithmetic ran (return_basis), or why a neighbour was unusable (holdings_price_return_reason). Those are separate axes on the same row, and collapsing any two of them is the defect ruling 18 corrected: FLOW_UNRECONCILED alone could not distinguish the guard disagreeing from the guard never running, and both were served under one label.
rule24_record.iv_state_coherence: WHICH VALUES ONE REMEDY DOES NOT MOVE. Landing the IRPT_BCKEND signed-basket instrument (ruling 20's named enrichment) would move NOT_GRADED_OUTSIDE_DOMAIN toward the GRADED members and would move nothing else. Repairing an upstream delivery gap moves GUARD_NOT_REACHED only. Widening the derived ceiling moves part of NOT_GRADED_OUTSIDE_DOMAIN and cannot touch NOT_GRADED_NO_NEIGHBOUR, which needs a holdings row to exist at all. GRADED_DISAGREED is moved by none of them: it is the one member that reports a real disagreement between two computations rather than an absence, so no coverage remedy can reduce it.

rule24_record.token_census_method: A TRAP THIS CENSUS WALKED INTO, recorded because it would mislead the next reader: the 1 hit on GRADED_AGREED and GRADED_DISAGREED is the INSTRUMENT'S OWN FOOTPRINT. comp-find logs every query and the corpus includes those logs, so a token census run twice finds its first run. The hits were identified BY PATH before being dismissed, not assumed away.
rule24_record.token_census_finding: NO COLLISION. All five members are absent from first-party source. The column NAME guard_state exists elsewhere as a FUNCTION (def guard_state(path) in a CVO deliverable script, answering a file-path question) and in no served or declared SCHEMA anywhere in the estate: different grain, different intent, no shared consumer. Adopting the name here is therefore not a Rule 24 (iii) cross-table intent collision. Stated as a measurement rather than a reassurance -- the function is named, its file is named, and a reader can disagree.

member_evidence.live_run: 473 rows, 83 trading days (2026-06-01..2026-09-28), the six round-1 accounts, graded against MEASURED_THRESHOLDS_R1 at tolerance 0.001244: GRADED_AGREED 152, NOT_GRADED_OUTSIDE_DOMAIN 309, GUARD_NOT_REACHED 10, GRADED_DISAGREED 2, NOT_GRADED_NO_NEIGHBOUR 0. Zero nulls, zero values outside the declared set, zero rows carrying HOLDINGS_INCOME_FALLBACK.
member_evidence.unexercised_member_proved_by_mutant: NOT_GRADED_NO_NEIGHBOUR is 0 on live data, and a declared member nothing produces is the exact defect SOURCE_LAG had. Proved with a sealed mutant: with the neighbour table forced empty, all 5 rows of a control window take NOT_GRADED_NO_NEIGHBOUR and stay MEASURED/TWR with a served value (correct: their flow is within the tolerance). The same window unmutated gives GRADED_AGREED 5.

served_day_rules.authority: 1.0.0_SA_CTO~DELL2 msg 7330 (2026-10-13), a clarification that changes no column, no enum and no hash; it states what the served columns already carry for a reader that folds this table into a window.
served_day_rules.graded_disagreed: A GRADED_DISAGREED day serves no number (ruling 17): a window that contains one reads ABSENT, with its reason and the count of such days, and is never compounded around the gap.
served_day_rules.flow_unreconciled: A FLOW_UNRECONCILED day compounds as served, and the window carries the flag with its count ("includes N unreconciled-flow days").
